description:
List the events the authenticated user has registered to attend on
Zindies — their own RSVPs only (made with rsvp_event or the "join"
button on an event page). Use it for "which events am I going to?",
"what did I sign up for next month?" or "which events did I attend?".
It never returns other participants or how many people joined.

To join or cancel use rsvp_event. For events the user only follows
(bookmarked without joining) use list_my_favorites with type: "event".
For public events to choose from use list_events; for one event's
venue, booths and programs pass an `id` from here to get_event.

Requires a Bearer token (a User API token, or an OAuth token with the
participations:read scope). Without one the server answers HTTP 401
("unauthorized"), and with a token lacking the scope HTTP 403
("insufficient_scope"); both carry a WWW-Authenticate header that
starts the OAuth sign-in.

Returns `events`, `count` (events in this response), `when` and
`has_more`. Each event has the fields list_events returns (`id`,
`event_type` with its dates, `title`, `location`, `kind`, `area`,
`url`, `place` / `facility`, `organizer`, `created_at`, `listed_at`)
plus `cancelled` (true when the organizer called the event off; the
RSVP itself is still listed), `comment` (the user's own public comment
on their participation, or null) and `joined_at`.

No matching RSVP returns `events: []`, not an error. An event whose
announcement date was moved to the future is left out until then.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return. When `has_more` is true, call again with `offset` raised by this many.

locale.description: Response language for translatable text fields (names, titles, descriptions): ja = Japanese, en = English, ko = Korean, zh-TW = Traditional Chinese. Pass the language the user is conversing in when it is one of these; otherwise omit it. Fields without a translation fall back to their source language (usually Japanese), so one response can mix languages. Tokens, ids, dates and URLs are the same in every locale. Default: ja.

offset.description: Number of events to skip from the start of the order `when` gives, for the next page: 0 (default) for the first page, then `offset` + `limit` while `has_more` is true.

when.description: `upcoming` (default) = events that have not ended yet, including ones under way now, soonest first; `past` = events that have ended, most recent first. There is no date-range filter: read each event's dates to narrow further.

name: list_my_participations
title: List events you joined
